school: 北宋'续古成新、法度备存'的知识工程师：用《本草图经》的'具图以进'让全帝国成为知识采集网络，用《新仪象法要》的图文互证与法度备存让机器在书里活过三次王朝更替，用天衡擒纵把波动的水流切成均匀节拍，用'验之即古，考之于今'把真正的新器写进旧谱系，用五十六年'不立异以邀名，不附势以固宠'的生存工程穿越四场党争，最后以《魏公谭训》式的'格言＋案例＋语境'把判断力封装成可传承的档案
historical_significance: 苏颂（1020-1101），字子容，泉州同安人，北宋政治家、天文学家、药物学家，历仕仁宗至徽宗五朝，官至宰相，谥'正简'：嘉祐二年（1057）奉诏主持编《本草图经》二十卷，收药七百八十余种、配图九百余幅，命全国各州府'具图以进'——实物样本与绘图同源上报，是中国药学史上第一次系统性的图文互证全国普查；元祐三年（1088）与吏部小吏韩公廉合作建成水运仪象台，高约十二米，以水力驱动、天衡擒纵机构控制匀速，集浑仪观测、浑象演示、报时三器于一体，顶层发明可开合活板观测室，为世界天文台设计之先声；著《新仪象法要》三卷，绘图百余幅、法度备存，仪象台在靖康之变被金人拆走后，金元之际据书重印，郭守敬据以改制简仪；两次使辽皆录行程底册，主持编《华戎鲁卫信录》二百二十九卷；任吏部尚书时详练典故、'每除一官，必审其可'，晚年与子孙同住亲课，家训由曾孙苏象先录成《魏公谭训》十卷，苏家科第不绝——五朝不倒而事功不断，是宋代'体制内长期创新者'的极致样本
historical_significance_en: Su Song (1020-1101), courtesy name Zirong, of Tong'an in Quanzhou, statesman, astronomer and pharmacologist of the Northern Song, serving five reigns from Renzong to Huizong, rising to chief minister, posthumously 'Upright and Simple': in 1057 he directed the Illustrated Classic of Materia Medica in twenty juan — over 780 drugs, more than 900 images, the prefectures commanded to 'submit with drawings,' specimens and pictures from one source, the first systematic empire-wide survey with text and image in mutual proof; in 1088, with the minor clerk Han Gonglian, he built the water-driven armillary clock tower, about twelve meters high, water-driven and held even by the tian-heng escapement, fusing observation, demonstration and time-announcing in one structure, its top story with the world's first hinged observing panels; his New Design for an Armillary Clock, three juan with over a hundred drawings and 'the whole craft kept in readiness,' let the book raise the machine again after the Jin carried it off — reprinted in the Jin, and Guo Shoujing built the simplified instrument from its remnants; twice envoy to Liao he kept baseline registers, and directed the 229-juan Record of Trust between Hua and the Foreign States; in the ministry of personnel 'each appointment examined against the record,' in old age tutoring his sons and grandsons, the maxims recorded in the Family Talks of Duke Wei by his great-grandson, the Su house keeping its examination line — five reigns without a fall and work unbroken, the extreme sample of the durable innovator within a system
unique_thinking: 苏颂思维模式的独特性在于六条主线的合成：第一，'图文互证'——知识用两种独立载体互相锁死，凡单一载体记录的知识都有无声走样的通道；第二，'向下张网'——书本记结论，工匠存方法，把每个领域的实际操作者当作活体索引，采集与验证同网收紧；第三，'法度备存'——工程的可复现性不是副产品而是主产品，把制造过程档案化是对抗时间最硬的技术；第四，'续古成新'——先考据出'中断的正统'，再以'补前人之未备'命名突破，让传统替创新担保；第五，'离散化驯服波动'——天衡擒纵证明不指望输入完美，而是造机构把波动切成均匀节拍；第六，'生存与传承并修'——以'不立异、不附势'留在牌桌上五十六年，以'格言＋案例＋语境'的谭训档案把判断力传过代际；六线共同指向一件事：把知识、器物、人才与家训都做成可核对、可复现、可传承的系统
unique_thinking_en: The distinctiveness of Su Song's thinking is a synthesis of six lines. First, mutual proof of text and image: knowledge locked by two independent carriers, for knowledge in a single carrier has a silent channel of drift. Second, the net spread downward: books hold conclusions, workmen hold methods — every practitioner a living index, gathering and checking the same net's two tightenings. Third, the whole craft kept in readiness: reproducibility is not a by-product of engineering but its chief product, and archiving the process of making is the hardest technology against time. Fourth, continuing the ancients to make the new: collate the interrupted orthodoxy, name the breakthrough as filling what the ancients left unfilled, and let tradition stand surety for innovation. Fifth, taming fluctuation by discretizing: the tian-heng proves one need not expect the input to be perfect — build the mechanism that cuts the wave into even beats. Sixth, survival and succession together: 'no novelty, no faction' kept him at the table fifty-six years, and the Family Talks — maxim, case, context — packaged judgment to cross the generations. The six lines share one direction: making knowledge, instruments, talent and family maxims into systems that are checkable, reproducible and transmissible
civilization_zh: 十一世纪的北宋——从汴京的浑仪与漏刻到江南的药田与驿站：王安石的新法与司马光的旧党在朝堂上翻覆，而一个泉州籍的官员在五十六年宦海里同时做成了三件事：编出一部全国药普查、造出一座水力驱动的天文钟楼、写下让后世工匠可按图复造的法度；韩公廉的小吏出身挡不住他把制造托付给他，曾孙的笔墨让他的家训再活五百年——在'祖宗之法'与'熙宁新法'之间，苏颂走的是第三条路：续古人之正统，成当世之新器，留后世之法度
civilization_en: The Northern Song of the eleventh century — from the armillary spheres and clepsydras of Kaifeng to the drug fields and relay stations of Jiangnan: Wang Anshi's New Policies and Sima Guang's old party overturning at court, while an official of Quanzhou stock in fifty-six years of office accomplished three things at once — a national survey of drugs, a water-driven astronomical clock tower, and the method by which later craftsmen could rebuild it from the page; the petty rank of Han Gonglian did not stop him from entrusting the making to the man, and the brush of his great-grandson let his family talks live five hundred years more; between 'the ancestors' law' and 'the new law of Xining,' Su Song took a third road: continuing the orthodoxy of the ancients, achieving new instruments for his own age, and leaving the whole craft in readiness for posterity
roles_zh: 《本草图经》的主持编纂者与全国药普查设计者
水运仪象台的主持建造者（与韩公廉）
《新仪象法要》的作者、仪器史与可复现工程的奠基人
两度使辽的外交官与《华戎鲁卫信录》主编
历仕五朝官至宰相、'不立异不附势'的生存工程师
《魏公谭训》所载家训的原作者与传承系统的设计者
roles_en: Director of the Illustrated Classic of Materia Medica and designer of the national drug survey
Builder of the water-driven armillary clock tower (with Han Gonglian)
Author of the New Design for an Armillary Clock, founder of instrument history and reproducible engineering
Twice envoy to Liao and editor of the 229-juan Record of Trust
Survival engineer of five reigns and chief minister, 'no novelty, no faction'
Author of the family maxims of the Family Talks of Duke Wei and designer of their transmission system

cross_references.description_zh: 苏颂与郭守敬是同一传统的两代承重者：郭守敬改制简仪时读的正是苏颂《新仪象法要》的残本——苏颂以'法度备存'预想了失传，郭守敬以可复现工程兑现了这份预想；两人都相信仪器精度是天文改革的地基，都把制造过程本身写成可传世的文档；差异在于苏颂更重档案与体制内的生存，郭守敬更重实测与度量的统一。
cross_references.description_en: Su Song and Guo Shoujing are two load-bearing generations of one tradition: refashioning the simplified instrument, Guo read the remnants of Su Song's New Design — Su Song foresaw loss with 'the whole craft kept in readiness,' and Guo redeemed that foresight with reproducible engineering; both held instrument precision the foundation of astronomical reform, both wrote the process of making into documents that outlive them; the difference: Su Song leaned to the archive and survival within the system, Guo to measurement and the unification of standards.

cross_references.description_zh: 苏颂与董仲舒代表了知识人面对权力的两副身位：董仲舒以天人三策自上而下供应整套意识形态，用体系换取采纳；苏颂以'修复先朝旧制'的名义让创新免于站队，用姿态换取空间——一个制造共识等待采纳，一个让新旧两党都无从反对；对照命题：在组织里推动新事物，体系的说服与姿态的中立是两条同样真实的通路。
cross_references.description_en: Su Song and Dong Zhongshu stand for two postures of the lettered before power: Dong supplied a whole ideology top-down in the three answers on heaven and man, trading a system for adoption; Su Song let innovation escape faction under the name of 'restoring an old institution of former reigns,' trading posture for space — one built consensus and waited, the other left neither party able to oppose; the contrast: moving the new through an organization, persuasion by system and neutrality of stance are two equally real roads.

cross_references.description_zh: 苏颂与黄宗羲都把'可复现'当作知识的试金石：苏颂的《新仪象法要》让三百年后的工匠按图复造仪器，黄宗羲的《明儒学案》让后人按学案重走各家思想的来路——两人都以文档的完备性对抗失传，都相信'法度备存'是对抗时间的方式；差异在于一个面向器物与工匠，一个面向思想与学者。
cross_references.description_en: Su Song and Huang Zongxi both make reproducibility the touchstone of knowledge: Su's New Design let craftsmen three centuries on rebuild the instruments from the page, Huang's Case Studies of Ming Confucians let later minds rewalk each school's route — both fought loss with the completeness of documents, both held 'the whole craft kept in readiness' the way against time; the difference: one faced things and craftsmen, the other thought and scholars.

cross_references.description_zh: 苏颂与杜牧是'知识服务于世'的两种时间观：杜牧以策论与绝句做当下的进言——知识要快、要锋利、要能被立刻执行；苏颂以档案与法度做千年的交付——知识要慢、要完备、要能被几百年后复现；一个把知识交给这一代人，一个把知识交给第三个王朝以后的人；对照命题：知识的有用性有两个刻度——此刻的可执行与百年的可重建。
cross_references.description_en: Su Song and Du Mu hold two views of time in knowledge serving the world: Du Mu's policy essays and quatrains advised the present — fast, keen, executable at once; Su Song's archives and methods delivered across a millennium — slow, complete, reproducible centuries later; one handed knowledge to his own generation, one to those after the third dynasty to come; the contrast: knowledge has two scales of use — the executable now and the rebuildable in a hundred years.

modes.name_en: The Method of Text-Illustration Mutual Proof
modes.category: 方法论/知识载体的双轨工程
modes.domain_zh: 苏颂主持编《本草图经》（1061），他给全国各州下了一个反常的命令：不只报药名和性状，必须连实物样本与手绘图一起送——文字描述'叶似某某'永远有歧义，而一幅真图加一段实测文字互相锁死，伪造与误认无处藏身；三十年后造水运仪象台，他把同一原则用到极致：《新仪象法要》里每台机器配整套图纸，机械图、零件图、装配图与文字说明逐条对应，'图像精具，其说详备'；他证明：知识的可靠性不取决于文字的精细，而取决于两种独立载体能否互相约束——凡是只有单一载体记录的知识，都存在无声走样的通道
modes.domain_en: When Su Song directed the Illustrated Classic of Materia Medica (1061), he gave the prefectures an unusual command: report not only names and properties of the drugs but send actual specimens with hand drawings — a verbal description 'leaves like such a plant' always leaves ambiguity, while a true picture and a passage of measured text lock each other down, leaving forgery and misidentification nowhere to hide; thirty years later, building the water-driven armillary clock tower, he drove the same principle to its end: the New Design for an Armillary Clock pairs every machine with a full set of drawings — mechanism, parts, assembly — matched line by line to the text, 'the images precisely provided, the explanations detailed'; he proved that the reliability of knowledge depends not on the fineness of the words but on whether two independent carriers can constrain each other — any knowledge recorded in a single carrier has a silent channel of distortion
modes.source_chapter: 苏颂《本草图经·序》：'今天下所上绘事千名……使玉石分区，真伪相乱，实为深害'；其奏请'下诸路州府，具图以进'；《新仪象法要》：'今则兼采诸家之说，考以旧史……备为图象'
modes.key_quote_zh: 文字有歧义，图无歧义；图文互证，走样无路——单一载体记录的知识都存在无声变形的通道
modes.key_quote_en: "Words leave room for drift, a picture does not; text and image proving each other leave distortion no road — knowledge in a single carrier has a silent channel of change."
process_zh: 识别单一载体的失真风险：凡是靠文字、口头或单一图表传递的关键知识（药品、流程、机械），先问'哪里可能被无声地走样'——歧义点是双轨工程的起点
选择与文字独立度最高的第二载体：对实物用图，对空间用测绘，对声音用谱——第二载体必须与第一载体有不同类型的误差，才能互相锁死
强制双载体同源提交：像苏颂命令各州'连样本带图一起送'那样，禁止二次转述——图与文必须出自同一现场、同一人手，否则对照失效
建立仲裁规则：图文冲突时以实物/实测为准，并记录冲突本身——冲突是发现错误描述的免费信号，不是麻烦
process_en: Identify the risk of drift in a single carrier: for key knowledge passed by words, speech or one chart — drugs, processes, machines — first ask 'where can it be silently distorted'; the points of ambiguity are where the dual-track work begins
Pick a second carrier maximally independent of the words: for objects, pictures; for space, survey; for sound, notation — the second carrier must err differently from the first, or they cannot lock

Force same-source submission of both: as Su Song ordered the prefectures to send samples and drawings together, forbid secondhand relay — image and text must come from the same site and the same hand, or the comparison fails
Set an arbitration rule: when text and image conflict, the specimen or measurement wins, and record the conflict itself — a conflict is a free signal of a wrong description, not a nuisance
representative_cases_zh: 《本草图经》的全国普查：苏颂奏请朝廷下令各州府'具图以进'，药农与医家把实物连同绘图逐级上报，全书收药七百八十余种、配图九百余幅——宋代以前任何本草著作都没有做到图文与实物同源
《新仪象法要》的图纸体系：全书一百多幅图，有总装、有分件、有传动原理示意，文字只负责图无法表达的尺寸与次序——三百年后朝鲜、日本的工匠能按书复造，靠的是图文逐条对应
五幅星图的精度：他绘制的星图记录一千四百六十四颗恒星，画法遵循'圆图'与'横图'并用——同一个星空用两种投影各画一遍，投影误差互相暴露，这是图文互证在天图上的直接应用
representative_cases_en: The empire-wide survey of the Illustrated Classic: Su Song petitioned the court to order every prefecture to 'submit with drawings'; farmers and physicians sent specimens with their pictures up through the ranks — the book gathered over 780 drugs and more than 900 images, the first Chinese pharmacology with text, picture and specimen of one source

The drawing system of the New Design: over a hundred figures — general assembly, parts, transmission schematics — with text carrying only the dimensions and sequences a picture cannot; three centuries later craftsmen in Korea and Japan could rebuild from the book, by the line-by-line pairing of image and text

The precision of the five star charts: his charts record 1,464 stars, drawn in both round and flat projections — the same sky drawn twice in two mappings, each exposing the other's error; the mutual-proof principle applied directly to the heavens
modern_applications_zh: 工程交付的双轨标准：给任何交接文档配'非文字副本'——流程配录屏、配置配快照、接口配可执行样例——验收时以副本为准而不以描述为准，交接走样率直接归零
实验记录的'样本即结论'规则：论文与报告的关键数据必须附原始产物/数据包/代码快照，而不是只附图表——审稿人能复现的不是文字而是样本，苏颂的'连样本带图一起送'就是同行评审的原始形态
知识库的防走样审计：每季度抽查知识库里只以单一载体存在的条目（只有口头传承、只有截图、只有聊天记录），为其补第二载体——凡单轨知识都列在'随时会变形'清单上
modern_applications_en: A dual-track standard for engineering handover: pair every handover document with a non-text copy — process with a screen recording, configuration with a snapshot, interface with a runnable sample; acceptance goes by the copy, not the description, and drift in handover goes to zero

The 'specimen is the conclusion' rule for lab records: key data in papers and reports must ship with the original artifact — data package, code snapshot, product sample — not just charts; what a reviewer can reproduce is not the words but the specimen, and Su Song's 'samples and drawings together' is peer review in its original form

A drift audit for the knowledge base: each quarter sample the entries that exist in a single carrier only — only oral tradition, only screenshots, only chat logs — and give each a second carrier; every single-track item goes on the list of 'liable to change shape at any time'

modes.name_en: The Method of Asking the Many Workmen
modes.category: 认知方法/知识采集的向下索引
modes.domain_zh: 《本草图经》的原料不来自藏书楼而来自田野：苏颂的设计是让药农、渔夫、猎户、医家成为知识网络的末梢——'上自儒医，下至野夫'的辨别经验都被征集入册；造仪象台时他遍访'知天文历算者'，寻到小吏韩公廉，先出题目考他：'验之即古，考之于今'——考察通过才把整个天文机械工程托付给他；苏颂的方法论立场很明确：书本记的是结论，工匠身上存的是方法，而方法只活在使用里；他证明：系统化的知识采集不必等待天才，只需一张向下张开的网——把每个领域的实际操作者都当作活体索引，按需逐人提问
modes.domain_en: The raw material of the Illustrated Classic came not from the library but from the field: Su Song's design made herb farmers, fishermen, huntsmen and physicians the tips of a knowledge network — the discernment of 'physicians above and countrymen below' was all collected into the book; building the clock tower he sought out 'those who knew astronomy and reckoning,' found the minor clerk Han Gonglian, first set him a test — 'verify it against the ancients, examine it against the present' — and only after he passed did he hand him the whole astronomical-mechanical works; his methodological stance was plain: books hold conclusions, workmen hold methods, and methods live only in use; he proved that systematic gathering of knowledge need not wait for genius — it needs a net spread downward, taking every practitioner in a field as a living index and questioning them one by one as needed
modes.source_chapter: 《本草图经·序》：'虽书传所载，固有名家议论……而田野之间，人自为说'；苏颂荐韩公廉事见《新仪象法要·进仪象状》：'访求知晓天文历算者'；得其人'检验试验，皆有凭据'
modes.key_quote_zh: 书本记的是结论，工匠身上存的是方法——方法只活在使用里，向下张网，逐人提问
modes.key_quote_en: "Books hold conclusions; the workman holds the method — and the method lives only in use; spread the net downward and question them one by one."
process_zh: 列出知识的'持有者地图'：把要采集的知识按领域列出实际操作者（药农之于本草、吏员之于律例、运维之于系统），而不是只列著作——持有者地图比书目更接近真相
设计低门槛的提交格式：苏颂命令各州'具图以进'，给药农的是一件画图的具体任务而不是一份论文——任务越具体，末梢参与者越多，网络覆盖越广
对关键人设置验证题：像考韩公廉那样，把候选专家的知识先过一道'验之即古，考之于今'的实测——头衔与口碑不算数，题目才算数
把采集结果回到网络校验：辑得的说法交叉比对多人多源，冲突处再向两端追问——采集与校验是同一张网的两次收紧
process_en: Map the holders of the knowledge: list for each field its actual practitioners — herb growers for pharmacology, clerks for statute, operators for systems — not only the books; the holder map lies nearer truth than the bibliography

Design a low-threshold submission format: Su Song asked the prefectures to 'submit with drawings' — a concrete task of drawing, not a dissertation; the more concrete the task, the wider the network's tips and the greater its coverage

Set verification questions for key people: as with Han Gonglian, pass the candidate's knowledge through one live test — 'verify against the ancients, examine against the present'; titles and reputation count nothing, the question counts

Return the gathered material to the network for checking: cross-compare each claim across many people and sources, and where they conflict, press both ends again — gathering and checking are two tightenings of the same net
representative_cases_zh: 《本草图经》的数据结构：每个药条目由'州府所绘图＋正文考订＋诸家异说'三层构成——野夫的说法与名医的议论并列入册，由苏颂作最后一层校订，这在十一世纪是惊人的去中心化设计
选韩公廉的考题过程：苏颂不问出身（韩只是太史局小吏），只出天文历算题目当场试之，试中即委以制器之任——后来水运仪象台的核心机构设计多半出自韩公廉之手
使辽途中的采集习惯：苏颂两次使辽，沿途记山川、物产、风俗、驿程——他不是去办外交顺便观光，而是把出使本身当成一次定向知识采集，归来所记成为宋辽交涉的地理底册
representative_cases_en: The data structure of the Illustrated Classic: each drug entry has three layers — the drawing submitted by the prefecture, the collated main text, and the variant sayings of many schools; the countryman's account and the famous physician's discussion stand side by side, with Su Song making the final revision — a startlingly decentralized design for the eleventh century

The examination of Han Gonglian: Su Song asked no rank — Han was a petty officer of the astronomical bureau — but set problems in astronomy and reckoning on the spot, and on passing entrusted him with the making of the instruments; the core mechanism of the clock tower was largely Han's design

The gathering habit of the Liao missions: twice sent as envoy, Su Song recorded the rivers and passes, products, customs and relay stations along the way — diplomacy was not a duty with sightseeing but a directed collection of knowledge, and his notes became the geographic register for Song-Liao negotiation
modern_applications_zh: 组织的'末梢索引'制度：新项目立项前先画持有者地图——谁真正操作过这条流水线、这批客户、这段代码——访谈名单以操作者优先、以管理者为辅，两周内能拿到文献里查不到的三成关键细节
外部专家的'出题验证'：聘请顾问前先给一道具体小题限时完成，验收质量再谈合作——韩公廉法把'大师'光环与真实能力分开，避免把项目托付给头衔
社群知识采集的'低门槛格式'：做行业调研时设计人人可填的提交模板（一张图＋三行说明），而不是问卷轰炸——苏颂'具图以进'证明：格式越具体，末梢贡献者越多
modern_applications_en: A tip-index system for organizations: before a project starts, draw the holder map — who has actually run this line, this client, this code — and interview operators before managers; in two weeks you gain the thirty percent of key detail no document holds

Question-testing outside experts: before engaging a consultant, set one small concrete task with a deadline and judge the work before the contract; the Han Gonglian method separates the aura of 'master' from real capability, keeping projects out of titled hands

Low-threshold formats for community collection: for industry research design a template anyone can fill — one picture, three lines of note — rather than bombarding with questionnaires; Su Song's 'submit with drawings' proves the more concrete the format, the more contributors at the tips
representative_figures: 塞缪尔·约翰逊（辞典的读者来信网）
modes.definition_zh: 《本草图经》的原料不来自藏书楼而来自田野：苏颂的设计是让药农、渔夫、猎户、医家成为知识网络的末梢——'上自儒医，下至野夫'的辨别经验都被征集入册；造仪象台时他遍访'知天文历算者'，寻到小吏韩公廉，先出题目考他：'验之即古，考之于今'——考察通过才把整个天文机械工程托付给他；苏颂的方法论立场很明确：书本记的是结论，工匠身上存的是方法，而方法只活在使用里；他证明：系统化的知识采集不必等待天才，只需一张向下张开的网——把每个领域的实际操作者都当作活体索引，按需逐人提问
modes.definition_en: The raw material of the Illustrated Classic came not from the library but from the field: Su Song's design made herb farmers, fishermen, huntsmen and physicians the tips of a knowledge network — the discernment of 'physicians above and countrymen below' was all collected into the book; building the clock tower he sought out 'those who knew astronomy and reckoning,' found the minor clerk Han Gonglian, first set him a test — 'verify it against the ancients, examine it against the present' — and only after he passed did he hand him the whole astronomical-mechanical works; his methodological stance was plain: books hold conclusions, workmen hold methods, and methods live only in use; he proved that systematic gathering of knowledge need not wait for genius — it needs a net spread downward, taking every practitioner in a field as a living index and questioning them one by one as needed

modes.name_en: The Method of Keeping the Whole Craft Ready
modes.category: 方法论/可复现性的档案工程
modes.domain_zh: 水运仪象台建成两年后，苏颂做了一件当时无人理解的事：把整座仪器的制造原理、尺寸比例、装配次序写成《新仪象法要》进呈皇帝——他预见了'物成而法失'的命运：铜台矗立在开封，但会随朝代倾覆；唯有书上的法度可以让毁掉的东西在任何时代被重建；他在进状里说明白：'其法度备存'，连'失传'二字都替后人想好了对策；靖康之变后仪象台果然被金人拆运北去，中原无人能再建，金人重印《新仪象法要》，元初郭守敬据残本改制简仪——三百年间机器死了三次，书让它活了三次；他证明：工程的可复现性不是副产品而是主产品——把制造过程本身档案化，是对抗时间最硬的技术
modes.domain_en: Two years after the water-driven clock tower rose, Su Song did what no one then understood: he wrote the whole craft — principles, dimensions, proportions, order of assembly — into the New Design for an Armillary Clock and presented it to the throne; he foresaw the fate of 'the thing made and the method lost': the bronze tower stood in Kaifeng, but would fall with a dynasty; only the method in the book could rebuild what was destroyed in any age; in his memorial he said plainly 'the whole craft is kept in readiness,' answering for posterity the very word 'lost'; after the fall of the Northern Song the Jin carried the tower north, no one in the central plains could rebuild it, the Jin reprinted the New Design, and early in the Yuan Guo Shoujing refashioned the simplified instrument from its remnants — three hundred years, the machine died three times, and the book raised it three times; he proved that reproducibility is not a by-product of engineering but its chief product — to archive the process of making is the hardest technology against time
modes.source_chapter: 苏颂《进仪象状》：'欲使其传之永久……具为图象'；《新仪象法要》总说：'今述其法度，备录其形状'；史载靖康之变金人运走仪象，金元之际据《新仪象法要》重修浑仪事（《金史·历志》、《元史·天文志》）
modes.key_quote_zh: 其法度备存——机器会随朝代倾覆，书上的法度可以让毁掉的东西在任何时代被重建
modes.key_quote_en: "The whole craft kept in readiness — the machine falls with a dynasty; the method in the book can rebuild what was destroyed in any age."
process_zh: 在建成之时预演毁灭：问'如果这套东西明天被拆走，什么能让它复活'——答案就是你欠下的文档清单；复现文档不是功成后的点缀，是工程的一半
按'陌生工匠'标准写：假设读者是三百年后一个聪明但毫无传承的匠人，尺寸、比例、次序、失败回避一应俱全——不为懂的人写注解，为不懂的人写全部
档案与实物同速更新：法度要跟着每一次改动走，改一处、录一处——档案落后于实物的部分就是注定失传的部分
为档案安排'再版通道'：把文档交给会被重印的载体（官修书目、朝廷档案、可复制的手册）——苏颂进呈御府正是让书进入国家收藏，靖康之后金人果然据此重印
process_en: Rehearse destruction at the moment of completion: ask 'if this were dismantled tomorrow, what could raise it again' — the answer is the documentation you owe; reproducibility documents are not ornament after success but half the work

Write to the standard of the stranger craftsman: assume a reader three hundred years on, intelligent but heirless — dimensions, proportions, sequence, pitfalls complete; not annotations for those who know, the whole for those who do not
Update the archive at the speed of the thing: the record follows every change — change one place, record one place; whatever part of the archive lags the thing is the part destined to be lost

Arrange a reprint channel for the archive: give the documents to carriers that get reprinted — official bibliographies, state archives, copyable manuals; Su Song presented to the imperial library to place the book in state keeping, and after the conquest the Jin indeed reprinted it
representative_cases_zh: 《新仪象法要》的全文结构：先总图、再浑仪、浑象、水运机关逐节分述，天衡（擒纵机构）单列一节并给全套图——这是世界现存最早详述擒纵机构的文献，欧洲直到几百年后才出现同类图纸
进状中的自我辩护：有人以为苏颂著书是邀功，他在进状中说明目的在'传之永久'——把文档的价值说成国家的、后世的，为这份档案争到了官府收藏与再版的地位
郭守敬的承接：元代郭守敬改制简仪时能跳过前人未明说的细节，靠的正是《法要》里完整保留的尺寸与构造——苏颂在北宋写的'陌生工匠说明书'，被元代最顶尖的工程师当作业界标准使用
representative_cases_en: The structure of the New Design: general views first, then the armillary sphere, the celestial globe, the water-drive section by section, with the escapement (tian-heng) given a full section and complete drawings — the earliest surviving literature to detail an escapement mechanism, centuries before comparable drawings appeared in Europe

The self-defense in the memorial: some thought the book a bid for credit; in the memorial Su Song declared its purpose 'to be transmitted forever,' framing the archive as the nation's and posterity's — winning it official keeping and reprinting

Guo Shoujing's inheritance: when the Yuan astronomer refashioned the simplified instrument he could skip details predecessors left vague, thanks to the dimensions and construction fully kept in the New Design — Su Song's eleventh-century 'manual for the stranger craftsman' served the greatest Yuan engineer as his industry standard
modern_applications_zh: 关键系统的'毁灭预演'文档：每个核心系统交付时附一页'如果整个团队消失，需要什么能重建它'——清单覆盖代码、数据、密钥位置、隐性决策，交由外部存档，每年演练一次
开源项目的'法度备存'标准：发布前检查文档能否让一个聪明的新人在无 mentor 的情况下复现全部——尺寸（配置）、比例（参数）、次序（启动顺序）、失败回避（FAQ）四项缺一即视为未完成
个人知识的'进呈御府'：把个人最有价值的工程笔记放到会被长期托管与再版的地方（开源、出版、机构库）而不是私人硬盘——苏颂证明：档案的存活取决于它进入的通道，不取决于它写得多好
modern_applications_en: The destruction-rehearsal document for key systems: with each core system's delivery attach one page — 'if the whole team vanished, what is needed to rebuild it' — covering code, data, key locations, tacit decisions; archive it externally and drill it yearly

The 'whole craft ready' standard for open source: before release, check whether the docs let one clever newcomer reproduce everything with no mentor — dimensions (config), proportions (parameters), sequence (startup order), pitfalls (FAQ); any missing item means not done

The 'imperial library' move for personal knowledge: put your most valuable engineering notes where they will be hosted and reprinted — open source, publication, institutional repositories — not a private disk; Su Song shows an archive survives by the channel it enters, not by how well it is written

modes.name_en: The Method of Three Instruments in One Tower
modes.category: 方法论/系统集成的顶层设计
modes.domain_zh: 前代的天文台是三件事分开做的：浑仪观测、浑象演示、漏刻计时各是各的机器、各归各房；苏颂与韩公廉把它做进一座水运仪象台：一座约十二米高的木结构高台，底层是报时的水力驱动与轮机系统，中层是浑象演示球，顶层是浑仪观测台——并且顶层做成九间活板屋，'浑仪随天运转'时摘去屋板即可观测，这是世界天文史上最早的观测室可开合穹顶；动力的统一是关键：以恒定水流驱动枢轮，通过天衡擒纵机构把水流切成均匀节拍，同一个动力同时驱动报时、演示与观测三个系统；他证明：真正的集成不是把东西放在一起，而是为分散的部件找一个共同的心脏——动力的统一会倒逼各子系统的接口标准化
modes.domain_en: Earlier observatories did three things apart: the armillary sphere observed, the celestial globe demonstrated, the clepsydra kept time — separate machines in separate rooms; Su Song and Han Gonglian built them into one water-driven armillary clock tower: a wooden structure about twelve meters high, its base housing the hydraulic drive and wheelwork of the time-announcing system, its middle story the celestial globe, its top the armillary observation deck — with nine hinged panels, removed when the sphere followed the sky in its turning, the earliest operable observing aperture in astronomical history; the unity of power was the key: a steady flow of water drove the main wheel, the escapement cut the flow into even beats, and one power drove announcing, demonstration and observation together; he proved that true integration is not putting things side by side but finding a common heart for scattered parts — unified power forces the standardization of every subsystem's interface
modes.source_chapter: 《新仪象法要》：'为台三层……设水运浑仪于上，浑象于中，司辰于下'；'开南北向户，各为启闭'（活板观测窗）；《宋史·天文志》载仪象台'其高数丈，机轮隐于中'
modes.key_quote_zh: 真正的集成不是把东西放在一起，而是为分散的部件找一个共同的心脏——动力统一会倒逼接口标准化
modes.key_quote_en: "True integration is not putting things side by side but finding a common heart for scattered parts — unified power forces every interface into a standard."
process_zh: 盘点被分开做的同类功能：先承认现状的分散是历史偶然而非必然——观测、演示、计时本可共享一套时间基准，分开只是因为没人统一设计过
寻找共同的心脏：为所有子系统选一个共同的驱动源（水力、统一时钟、统一数据层）——心脏的选择决定集成的成败，宁可在心脏上多花一半预算
在接口处发明新机构：各子系统对接处往往没有现成方案，需要在缝隙处发明新零件（天衡之于轮机与水流、活板之于浑仪与屋顶）——集成的创新多半发生在接口而非部件
为最大部件留退路：让最精密的子系统保持可独立运转（浑仪可拆板单独观测）——集成不能绑架最精密的部分，集成失败时它要能自己活
process_en: Inventory the functions done apart: first admit that the present scatter is historical accident, not necessity — observation, demonstration and time-keeping could share one time base; they were apart only because no one had designed them together
Find the common heart: choose a common driver for all subsystems — water, a unified clock, a unified data layer; the choice of heart decides the integration, and half the budget belongs on the heart

Invent new mechanisms at the interfaces: where subsystems meet there is usually no ready part — invent it in the gap (the escapement between wheel and flow, the hinged panels between sphere and roof); the innovations of integration happen at interfaces, not parts

Leave the finest subsystem a retreat: keep the most precise part able to run alone — the armillary observed with panels removed; integration must not hold hostage the most delicate member; if integration fails, it must live on its own
representative_cases_zh: 十二米台的三层分工：底层五层轮机各司其时辰牌、昏晓报时，中层浑象与天球昼夜同步旋转，顶层浑仪'随天运转'——三层由同一条水链驱动，误差不积累，堪称十一世纪的统一时钟架构
活板观测室的发明：观测时摘去九块屋板，平时闭合遮风避雨——把'仪器精度'与'建筑防护'这对矛盾做成了可切换结构，比第谷的观测室早五百年
天衡擒纵的枢纽地位：枢轮的六十六个受水壶被一套杠杆机构逐个锁定与释放，把连续水流切成均匀节拍——没有这一件接口机构，三层机器只是三个摆在一起的玩具
representative_cases_en: The three stories of the twelve-meter tower: the base's wheelwork announcing the watches through placards, the middle globe turning in step with day and night, the top sphere following the sky — three stories driven by one water chain, errors not accumulating: a unified clock architecture of the eleventh century

The invention of the hinged observing panels: nine roof panels removed for observing, closed against wind and rain at other times — turning the contradiction between instrument precision and building shelter into a switchable structure, five hundred years before Tycho's observatory

The hub position of the escapement: a lever mechanism locked and released the sixty-six scoops of the main wheel one by one, cutting a continuous flow into even beats — without this one interface mechanism, the three stories were three toys set side by side
modern_applications_zh: 平台架构的'共同心脏'选型：整合多个工具前先定统一数据层/统一身份/统一调度器——心脏统一后各工具的接口自然被迫对齐，集成的工程量从'改每个工具'变成'只做心脏'
接口处的创新预算：把研发预算的固定比例留给部件之间的缝隙（适配层、协议转换、可开合结构）——苏颂的活板屋证明：最被后世记住的发明常常是接口而非部件
最精密子系统的独立性条款：任何集成方案必须回答'如果集成失败，最精密的部件能否退回独立运转'——没有退路的集成是绑架，有退路的集成才是联盟
modern_applications_en: Choosing the common heart of a platform: before integrating many tools, fix the unified data layer, identity or scheduler; once the heart is unified, tool interfaces align by force, and the work shrinks from 'changing every tool' to 'building only the heart'

An innovation budget for the interfaces: reserve a fixed share of R&D for the gaps between parts — adapters, protocol converters, operable structures; the hinged roof shows the invention posterity remembers is often the interface, not the part

The independence clause for the finest subsystem: every integration plan must answer 'if integration fails, can the most precise member return to running alone'; integration without retreat is hostage-taking; integration with retreat is an alliance

modes.definition_en: Earlier observatories did three things apart: the armillary sphere observed, the celestial globe demonstrated, the clepsydra kept time — separate machines in separate rooms; Su Song and Han Gonglian built them into one water-driven armillary clock tower: a wooden structure about twelve meters high, its base housing the hydraulic drive and wheelwork of the time-announcing system, its middle story the celestial globe, its top the armillary observation deck — with nine hinged panels, removed when the sphere followed the sky in its turning, the earliest operable observing aperture in astronomical history; the unity of power was the key: a steady flow of water drove the main wheel, the escapement cut the flow into even beats, and one power drove announcing, demonstration and observation together; he proved that true integration is not putting things side by side but finding a common heart for scattered parts — unified power forces the standardization of every subsystem's interface

modes.name_en: The Method of Continuing Heng by Honoring the Ancients
modes.category: 方法论/创新合法性的谱系工程
modes.domain_zh: 苏颂造仪象台，名义上不是发明而是'复原'：他在奏状与书序中反复把工程系于张衡、一行、梁令瓒的水运浑天传统之下——'验之即古，考之于今'；先考证古法确实存在（一行水运浑天的记载在唐书历历可查），再声明'古法已失、今为补足'，然后才把真正的新创造（擒纵机构的改进、三器集成）作为'补前人之未备'推出——在北宋的政治与学风中，'创新'是可疑的罪名，'补古'是无懈可击的功业；这套谱系话术不是狡辩而是真实的学术工作：他为追溯一行旧法所做的文献考据，本身把失传技术史的框架搭了起来；他证明：在一个敬畏传统的环境里，最有力的创新姿态是'继承者的入场'——把新东西写进旧谱系，让传统替创新担保
modes.domain_en: Su Song's clock tower was nominally not an invention but a restoration: in memorials and prefaces he anchored the works in the water-driven armillary tradition of Zhang Heng, Yi Xing and Liang Lingzan — 'verify against the ancients, examine against the present'; first establish that the ancient method truly existed (Yi Xing's water-driven sphere findable in the Tang histories), then declare 'the ancient method lost, today's a making-up of what was wanting,' and only then bring out the genuinely new — the improved escapement, the integration of three instruments — as 'filling what the ancients left unfilled'; in the politics and learning of the Song, 'innovation' was a suspect charge and 'mending the ancients' an unimpeachable merit; the genealogy was not casuistry but real scholarship: his collations in search of Yi Xing's old method themselves built the frame of a lost technical history; he proved that in a tradition-revering world the strongest posture of innovation is the heir's entrance — write the new into the old line, and let the tradition stand surety for innovation
modes.source_chapter: 苏颂《进仪象状》：'臣昨访得吏民有知天文历算者……验之即古，考之于今'；追述张衡候地动浑天仪、一行与梁令瓒水运浑天俯视图事（《晋书·天文志》、《旧唐书·天文志》）；《新仪象法要·序》：'考古用今'
modes.key_quote_zh: 验之即古，考之于今——把新东西写进旧谱系，让传统替创新担保
modes.key_quote_en: "Verify against the ancients, examine against the present — write the new into the old line, and let the tradition stand surety for innovation."
process_zh: 找到自己领域里的'失传正统'：在你的创新方向上，历史上是否存在过一条中断的正线——一条被认可但没人接着走的路；有，它就是你的入场券
先考据再创新：像苏颂考一行旧法那样，用文献与实证把'古法存在且已失'论证扎实——这个考据过程本身产出技术史框架，是创新的前置投资而非成本
以'补未备'命名突破：新东西不叫颠覆，叫'补前人之未备'——命名决定接受度，继承者姿态降低的只是心理门槛，不是技术门槛
让旧谱系检验新方案：'考之于今'是把新做法与古法的原始问题对表——若新方案能回答古法当年要解决的问题，继承关系就是真的；答不了，谱系就是伪装
process_en: Find the interrupted orthodoxy of your field: on the line of your innovation, was there ever an approved road no one continued — a real path cut off in mid-course; if so, it is your ticket of entrance

Collate before creating: as Su Song collated Yi Xing's method, establish by documents and evidence that 'the ancient method existed and was lost' — the collation itself yields the frame of technical history, an investment in the innovation, not a cost

Name the breakthrough as 'filling what was wanting': do not call the new a revolution; call it the unfilled gap of the ancients — naming decides acceptance; the heir's posture lowers only the psychological threshold, never the technical one

Let the old line test the new plan: 'examine against the present' means setting the new practice against the original problem of the ancients — if it answers what the old method set out to solve, the inheritance is real; if not, the genealogy is a disguise
representative_cases_zh: 奏状里的三段论：先引《旧唐书》一行梁令瓒水运浑天的成例，再指出'其法不传'，最后提出'臣等今补其法'——朝廷批钱造器时批的是'修复先朝旧制'，而实际造出的是当时世界最复杂的机械
考据的实质产出：为考张衡、一行旧制，苏颂系统梳理了历代天文仪器的文献记载——这段考订后来成为《新仪象法要》的历史章，使一部机械手册同时成了一部仪器史
与王安石党的对照：同时代的'新法'以'祖宗不足法'开路，激成党争；苏颂的'新器'以'先朝旧制'开路，新旧两党都无从反对——同一时代的两种创新姿态，结局截然不同
representative_cases_en: The syllogism in the memorial: first cite the Old Tang History on Yi Xing's and Liang Lingzan's water-driven sphere, then note 'the method is not transmitted,' finally offer 'your servants now mend its method'; the court approved funds for 'restoring an old institution of former reigns' — and what was built was the most complex mechanism in the world at that time

The real yield of the collation: tracing the old devices of Zhang Heng and Yi Xing, Su Song systematically ordered the documentary record of astronomical instruments through the ages — this collation became the historical chapter of the New Design, making a mechanical manual also a history of instruments

The contrast with Wang Anshi's party: the 'New Policies' of the same era opened with 'the ancestors are not to be imitated,' and ignited factional war; Su Song's 'new instrument' opened with 'an old institution of former reigns,' against which neither party could vote; two postures of innovation in one age, with utterly different ends
modern_applications_zh: 在保守组织里的'续谱入场'：向传统行业提案时，先做功课找到该行业'中断的正线'（曾被验证但中断的旧方案），把新方案命名为其续篇——银行、医疗、政府的评审室里，'补前人之未备'的通过率远高于'颠覆性创新'
创新前的'考据即投资'：动手前系统梳理该方向的历史尝试与失败原因——这份技术史既为创新提供谱系合法性，又直接暴露前人没踩过的空地
'答老问题'的真伪检验：给继承式创新设一道自检——新方案能否回答正统当年要解决的原始问题？能答才是续谱，不能答就是借壳；借壳的谱系会在细节处露出裂缝
modern_applications_en: The heir's entrance in conservative organizations: proposing into traditional industries, first find their interrupted orthodoxy — an old approach once proven and then abandoned — and name your plan its continuation; in the review rooms of banks, hospitals and government, 'filling what the ancients left unfilled' passes far more often than 'disruptive innovation'

Collation as investment before creation: before building, order the historical attempts of your direction and why each failed; that technical history grants the genealogy of legitimacy and directly exposes the ground no predecessor trod

The true-or-false test of 'answering the old question': give heir-style innovation a self-check — can the new plan answer the original problem the orthodoxy set out to solve? If yes, the lineage is real; if no, it is a borrowed shell, and a borrowed lineage cracks at the details
representative_figures: 哥白尼（托身托勒密传统）

modes.name_en: The Method of the Wheel Made Even by Water
modes.category: 方法论/把无序输入变成均匀节拍
modes.domain_zh: 水运仪象台最难的问题不是造大，而是'匀'：水的流量随季节、水位、阻力波动，而天文演示要求报时轮转得分毫不差；苏颂与韩公廉的解法是发明天衡——一套三重的擒纵机构：受水壶随枢轮旋转，转到顶部由天条、天衡杠杆系统逐壶锁定，注满定时释放，'左天锁''右天锁'交替把关，让连续的水流变成离散而均匀的节拍，一格一格驱动整台机器；欧洲类似的擒纵结构要到几个世纪后才出现在机械钟里；这个解法的思想内核是：不指望输入本身完美（水压、人的精力、信息的质量都天然波动），而是造一个机构把波动切成均匀的节拍——用离散化驯服连续的不稳定
modes.domain_en: The hardest problem of the clock tower was not size but evenness: water flow wavers with season, level and friction, while the astronomical demonstration demanded the wheels turn without a hair's difference; Su Song's and Han Gonglian's answer was the tian-heng, a triple escapement: the scoops turn on the main wheel, are locked one by one at the top by the rod-and-lever system, and release when filled to weight — the left and right locks taking turns — so that a continuous flow becomes a discrete, even beat driving the whole machine; comparable escapements appear in European clocks only centuries later; the inner thought of the solution: do not expect the input itself to be perfect — water pressure, human energy, the quality of information all fluctuate by nature — but build a mechanism that cuts the fluctuation into even beats; tame continuous instability by discretizing it
modes.source_chapter: 《新仪象法要·天衡》：'天衡，用以平枢轮之运转'；'左右天锁'、'天条'、'格叉'诸件与受水壶'逐壶受水，运行有节'；李约瑟《中国科学技术史》论天衡为机械钟擒纵机构之先声
modes.key_quote_zh: 不指望输入完美，而是造一个机构把波动切成均匀节拍——用离散化驯服连续的不稳定
modes.key_quote_en: "Do not expect the input to be perfect; build a mechanism that cuts the fluctuation into even beats — tame continuous instability by discretizing it."
process_zh: 承认输入天生波动：列出驱动系统的原始输入（水流、精力、现金流、注意力），为每一项标注它天然波动的幅度与周期——'输入不完美'是设计前提而不是缺陷
设计'逐壶锁定'的节拍器：找到把连续输入切成离散单元的机构（定时器、批处理、检查点、迭代），每个单元要么完整通过要么被锁住——没有半格
装双锁交替把关：在节拍器上再加一道确认机构（左右天锁式的双重检查），防止单点失效造成乱拍——关键的节拍处永远要有第二道锁
用节拍反推上游：匀速化之后，波动不再冲击系统而被记录在'等待释放的壶'里——节拍器顺带成了波动的测量仪，由此反推上游该在哪里补容量
process_en: Admit the input fluctuates by nature: list the raw inputs driving the system — water, energy, cash, attention — and mark each one's natural range and period; 'the input is imperfect' is the premise of design, not its defect

Build the scoop-lock metronome: find the mechanism that cuts continuous input into discrete units — timers, batches, checkpoints, iterations — each unit either passing whole or held locked; there is no half-beat
Fit the twin locks: add a confirming mechanism over the metronome — left and right locks in turn — so no single failure jumbles the beat; at every critical beat a second lock must stand

Read back upstream from the beat: once evened, fluctuation no longer strikes the system but collects in the scoops waiting release — the metronome doubles as a gauge of the fluctuation, pointing where upstream capacity is owed
representative_cases_zh: 受水壶的定容节拍：枢轮上六十六个水壶容积相同、注满即释——水流快慢只改变等待时间，不改变每次释放的机械功——这是'把波动隔离在缓冲区'思想的最早机械实现
格叉与关舌的细节：注水不足时壶被格叉托住不放，注满压弯关舌才解锁——机构自己完成了'质量检验'，不合格的节拍根本不进入系统
昼夜机轮的分层报时：匀速枢轮驱动多层木人按刻击鼓摇铃——匀速的上游才有可信的下游，报时的准点率建立在擒纵的节拍上
representative_cases_en: The fixed capacity of the scoops: sixty-six scoops of equal size on the main wheel, each releasing only when full — the speed of the flow changes only the waiting, never the mechanical work released; the earliest mechanical embodiment of 'isolating fluctuation in a buffer'

The detail of the fork and the tongue: a scoop underfilled is held by the fork and not released; only a full scoop pressing the tongue unlocks it — the mechanism performs its own quality check, and a bad beat never enters the system

The layered time-announcing wheels: the even main wheel drove tiers of jacks striking drums and bells on the marks; a trustworthy downstream is built on the evenness upstream — punctuality of the announcements rests on the beat of the escapement
modern_applications_zh: 个人精力的'天衡'制度：不做'能做多少做多少'的连续工作制，而是固定节拍的批次制（每批一个明确交付物、批次间强制休整）——波动被消化在批间休息里，产出质量不再随当日状态起伏
需求波动的缓冲节拍设计：面对不稳定的用户流量，用固定批次的发布/处理节奏代替即时响应——流量涨落只改变排队长度，不改变处理质量，排队长度反过来成为容量规划的测量仪
双锁制度：关键决策节拍（发布、交易、签约）设两道独立确认，第二道锁在第一道失误时拦下——天衡证明：最重要的不是节拍器本身，而是节拍处的那道多余的锁
modern_applications_en: A tian-heng for personal energy: replace 'do as much as possible' continuous work with a fixed-beat batch regime — one clear deliverable per batch, forced rest between batches; the fluctuation is absorbed in the rest, and quality no longer rises and falls with the day

Buffered beats for fluctuating demand: against unstable traffic, substitute a fixed-batch cadence of release and processing for instant response; the rise and fall changes only the queue, never the quality — and the queue becomes the gauge for capacity planning

The twin-lock system: give the critical beats of decision — release, trade, signature — two independent confirmations, the second stopping what the first mis-passes; the tian-heng teaches that what matters most is not the metronome but the superfluous lock at the beat

modes.name_en: The Method of the Living Bank of One's Own Reign
modes.category: 方法论/知识管理的传承设计
modes.domain_zh: 苏颂在元祐年任吏部尚书兼侍读，经他手提拔与保荐的人才里走出了后来居宰相之位者；但他更大的'知识传承'工程是另一件事：他把本朝的人才档案当作活的知识库经营——每一任官员的专长、政绩、品行记录在他主持修的官制档案里，'每有除拜，考其素履'；他晚年自述为官心得：'人生要处，知人最难'——他把'知人'当成和制器、修书同等规模的系统工作来做：不是靠印象与传闻，而是靠长期维护的记录与可核对的履历；苏颂官场五十六年不倒、历仕五朝而终获'正简'之谥，凭的不是权术而是这套档案化的人事方法论；他证明：人才的传承可以像器物的法度一样被档案化——'法度备存'的原则，同样适用于人
modes.domain_en: As director of the Ministry of Personnel and reader-in-waiting in the Yuanyou years, Su Song promoted men who would later stand among the chief ministers; but his greater work of 'handing over knowledge' was another: he ran the personnel files of his own reign as a living knowledge base — every official's specialty, deeds and character kept in the records he oversaw, 'each appointment examined against the record of the whole life'; he said in old age, 'in life the hardest thing is to know men' — and he made 'knowing men' a systematic work of the same scale as making instruments and compiling books: not by impressions and rumor, but by long-kept records and checkable careers; fifty-six years in office without falling, serving five reigns and ending with the posthumous name 'Upright and Simple,' he owed it not to craft but to this archival method of personnel; he proved that the succession of talent can be archived like the method of an instrument — the principle of 'the whole craft kept in readiness' applies to men as well
modes.source_chapter: 苏颂知人事铨选事见《宋史·苏颂传》：'颂在吏部，详练典故……每除一官，必审其可'；其自言'知人最难'见《魏公谭训》所记家训；谥'正简'事同传
modes.key_quote_zh: 人生要处，知人最难——人才的传承可以像器物的法度一样被档案化
modes.key_quote_en: "In life the hardest thing is to know men — the succession of talent can be archived like the method of an instrument."
process_zh: 把'识人'从印象改为记录：给关键协作者的专长、交付史、失败史建立可核对的档案——印象会被情绪改写，记录不会
以'素履'为考核单位：不考核一次表现而考核一贯轨迹——'每除一官，必审其可'：每次任用前先调全档，任用变成档案的检索而非现场的赌注
在位时即修'本朝活人档案'：不要等到离任才交接，档案在任内持续维护——苏颂在吏部任上即修典故，离任时整套方法随档案移交
把知人经验传成家训：苏颂对子孙的训诫（'知人最难'、'人生要处'）被曾孙苏象先记入《魏公谭训》——个人的判断诀窍只有写成文字才成为家族与组织的资产
process_en: Turn discernment from impression to record: keep checkable files of key collaborators — specialties, delivered work, failures; impressions are rewritten by mood, records are not

Take the whole walk of life as the unit of assessment: judge not one performance but the consistent track — 'each appointment examined against the record'; every appointment is a retrieval of the file, not a stake laid on the spot

Maintain the living personnel archive while in office: do not wait for departure to hand over; the archive is kept current in the role — Su Song compiled the precedents while serving in the ministry, and the whole method moved with the files

Pass the knack of knowing men as written maxims: Su Song's admonitions to his grandsons — 'the hardest thing is to know men' — were recorded by his great-grandson in the Family Talks of Duke Wei; a personal knack becomes an asset of family and organization only when written
representative_cases_zh: 吏部铨选的做法：苏颂任吏部尚书时对手下官员的擢用'详练典故、审定资序'——北宋吏部档案在他手里从例行文书变成实际决策工具，同僚称其'每除一官，必审其可'
《魏公谭训》的传承链：苏颂的言行、方法、家训由曾孙苏象先系统记录成书——这份档案让后人能看到'知人最难'这类判断背后的具体案例，而不是只有格言
荐人与担责的绑定：苏颂保荐官员有记录可查，被荐者后来的成败反过来校验他的知人记录——档案让荐举从人情变成有追踪的判断
representative_cases_en: The practice of selection in the ministry: as director of personnel Su Song made the archives a working instrument of decision — 'well versed in the precedents, weighing the order of service' — and colleagues noted that 'each appointment was examined for its fitness'; routine files became a real decision tool

The chain of the Family Talks of Duke Wei: Su Song's sayings, methods and family maxims were systematically recorded by his great-grandson Su Xiangxian — an archive that lets later readers see the concrete cases behind maxims like 'the hardest thing is to know men,' not the maxims alone

Recommendation bound to accountability: Su Song's recommendations were on record, and the later success or failure of the men recommended checked his record of judgment in turn — the archive turned recommendation from favor into traceable judgment
modern_applications_zh: 团队的'活人档案'：管理者为核心成员建立持续更新的档案（交付记录、判断案例、成长轨迹），任用与授权前先调档——把'我觉得他行'替换成'他的记录显示他行'
离任交接的'任内维护'条款：交接质量必须在任内持续投入而不是离职前突击——苏颂的典故随他五朝流转而不失，因为档案从第一天就是活的
个人判断诀窍的'谭训化'：把你屡次验证过的识人/决策口诀写成带案例的短文传给团队——格言会漂移，带案例的格言能穿越代际
modern_applications_en: A living file for the team: keep current records of core members — deliveries, cases of judgment, growth tracks — and pull the file before appointments and delegations; replace 'I think he can' with 'his record shows he can'

The 'maintain-in-office' clause of handover: handover quality is invested continuously in the role, not crammed before departure; Su Song's precedents passed through five reigns without loss because the archive was alive from the first day

Turning one's knack into 'family talks': write the repeatedly tested maxims of judgment about people — with cases — and pass them to the team; bare maxims drift, maxims with cases cross the generations
modes.definition_zh: 苏颂在元祐年任吏部尚书兼侍读，经他手提拔与保荐的人才里走出了后来居宰相之位者；但他更大的'知识传承'工程是另一件事：他把本朝的人才档案当作活的知识库经营——每一任官员的专长、政绩、品行记录在他主持修的官制档案里，'每有除拜，考其素履'；他晚年自述为官心得：'人生要处，知人最难'——他把'知人'当成和制器、修书同等规模的系统工作来做：不是靠印象与传闻，而是靠长期维护的记录与可核对的履历；苏颂官场五十六年不倒、历仕五朝而终获'正简'之谥，凭的不是权术而是这套档案化的人事方法论；他证明：人才的传承可以像器物的法度一样被档案化——'法度备存'的原则，同样适用于人
modes.definition_en: As director of the Ministry of Personnel and reader-in-waiting in the Yuanyou years, Su Song promoted men who would later stand among the chief ministers; but his greater work of 'handing over knowledge' was another: he ran the personnel files of his own reign as a living knowledge base — every official's specialty, deeds and character kept in the records he oversaw, 'each appointment examined against the record of the whole life'; he said in old age, 'in life the hardest thing is to know men' — and he made 'knowing men' a systematic work of the same scale as making instruments and compiling books: not by impressions and rumor, but by long-kept records and checkable careers; fifty-six years in office without falling, serving five reigns and ending with the posthumous name 'Upright and Simple,' he owed it not to craft but to this archival method of personnel; he proved that the succession of talent can be archived like the method of an instrument — the principle of 'the whole craft kept in readiness' applies to men as well

modes.name_en: The Method of Not Raising Novelty
modes.category: 个人品格/体制内的长期生存术
modes.domain_zh: 苏颂宦海五十六年，历经王安石变法、元祐更化、绍圣绍述——每一次翻覆都把大臣成批清洗，而他历任五朝、官至宰相、寿终相位；秘诀他自己说得平淡：'不立异以邀名，不附势以固宠'；新党当政时不谄附新法，元祐旧党上台时不追打新党——他在两种风暴里都做同一件事：守住技术判断与行政本分，不在站队游戏中下注；水运仪象台恰恰是在新旧党争最激烈的元祐年间建成进呈的——一件真正的新器物在'不立异'的姿态下完成，是他对'立异'与'创新'之别的最好注脚：器物可以新，姿态不能险；他证明：长期主义者的第一功课不是赢，而是留在牌桌上——体制内最持久的创新者往往是最低调的生存工程师
modes.domain_en: Fifty-six years in office, through Wang Anshi's New Policies, the Yuanyou reaction and the Shaoxing restoration — each overturn sweeping ministers away in batches — Su Song passed through five reigns, rose to chief minister, and died in the seat; his secret he stated plainly: 'raise no novelty to court fame, cling to no faction to keep favor'; under the New Policies he fawned on nothing, under the Yuanyou old party he hunted no new men — through both storms he did one thing: held his technical judgment and administrative duty, and placed no bet in the game of sides; the water-driven clock tower rose and was presented precisely in the Yuanyou years of fiercest strife — a genuinely new instrument completed in a posture of 'no novelty,' the best gloss on his distinction between novelty and innovation: the thing may be new, the posture must not be perilous; he proved the first task of the long-termist is not to win but to stay at the table — the most durable innovators within a system are often the quietest engineers of survival
modes.source_chapter: 《宋史·苏颂传》：'颂…不立异以邀名，不附势以固宠'；元祐间知杭州、进吏部尚书、拜相事；'正简'谥号及历仕仁宗至徽宗五朝事同传；《魏公谭训》记其处世家训
modes.key_quote_zh: 不立异以邀名，不附势以固宠——长期主义者的第一功课不是赢，而是留在牌桌上
modes.key_quote_en: "Raise no novelty to court fame, cling to no faction to keep favor — the first task of the long-termist is not to win but to stay at the table."
process_zh: 区分'事新'与'姿态险'：把要做的创新分成'器物层面'与'立场层面'——器物尽可以新（造仪象台、修本草），立场保持中位（不借新东西宣称旧路线错了）
为每次风暴预设中性位置：翻覆来临前问'这次变化里，不押注任何一方的动作是什么'——把技术本分（修书、治事、交付）作为风暴中的默认姿态
用交付物而非表态积累信誉：苏颂的免于清洗靠的是历朝都需要的实干记录（吏部典故、使辽底册、仪象台）——做每个体制都离不开的那个人，比做每任都想拉拢的那个人安全
把生存策略写成家训并示范给下一代：'不立异'不是怯懦而是把信誉当复利经营——向团队明示这套原则，让组织明白你的中立是纪律而不是墙头草
process_en: Separate new things from perilous postures: sort your innovation into the level of the thing and the level of stance — the thing may be wholly new (a clock tower, a pharmacology), the stance stays median (never claiming by the new thing that the old line was wrong)

Preset a neutral position for each storm: before every overturn ask 'in this change, what is the move that bets on no side' — making technical duty (books, works, delivery) the default posture within the storm

Bank reputation in deliverables, not declarations: Su Song survived on records every reign needed — the precedents of personnel, the Liao registers, the clock tower; be the person no administration can do without, safer than the one every administration wants to court

Write the survival policy as maxim and model it: 'no novelty' is not timidity but compound interest on reputation; state the principle plainly to the team, so your neutrality reads as discipline, not fence-sitting
representative_cases_zh: 元祐建台的政治时点：高太后与旧党当政、新党边缘化的当口，苏颂以'修复先朝旧制'名义上仪象台——不沾党争色彩的新器物，新旧两党都只能支持
与新党的具体摩擦处理：变法期间苏颂任地方官，对新法执行'不苟附、不显抗'，政绩照做——绍圣追复新法时他没有被列入旧党清洗名单
荐人的政治安全垫：他举荐人才据铨选档案而非派系关系，名单经得起任何一党的复核——程序化的用人让他在任何政敌手里都查不出私党
representative_cases_en: The political timing of the Yuanyou tower: at the height of the old party's power with the new men sidelined, Su Song presented the clock tower under 'restoring an old institution of former reigns' — a new instrument untainted by faction, which neither party could oppose

Handling friction with the New Policies: in provincial office under the reforms he 'neither fawned nor openly resisted,' doing his work regardless — when the Shaoxing restoration came he stood outside the lists of the old party's purge
The political safety of procedure: he recommended by archive rather than faction, the list open to any party's recheck — procedural staffing left his enemies nothing to call a private clique
modern_applications_zh: 组织换血期的'技术本分'策略：管理层更迭时不急于表忠或站队，把手头系统做成任何一届都必须依赖的基础（文档、稳定性、知识库）——苏颂的典故档案就是他的免死金牌
创新提案的'去姿态化'改写：提交激进方案时剥离路线宣示，只保留问题与方案——把'旧做法错了'从文档里删掉，创新通过的阻力立减一半
中立的明示化：对团队明确说明自己的不站队是纪律而非投机——中立一旦被理解成原则，就成了所有派系都可借用的资产
modern_applications_en: The 'technical duty' strategy in leadership turnover: when management changes, neither swear fealty nor line up at once; make your systems the foundation any administration must depend on — documents, stability, the knowledge base; Su Song's precedents were his immunity
De-posturing a radical proposal: strip route declarations from the pitch, keeping only problem and plan; delete 'the old way is wrong' from the document and half the resistance falls away
Making neutrality explicit: tell the team plainly that not taking sides is discipline, not opportunism; neutrality understood as principle becomes an asset every faction can borrow

modes.name_en: The Method of the Envoy's Baseline Register
modes.category: 方法论/情报的结构化采集
modes.domain_zh: 苏颂两次出使辽国，不是带着使命去、带着印象回，而是带着底册去、带着底册回：沿途山川形势、城邑道里、驿铺间距、物产风俗、军情虚实时时笔录，归而整编成册——这份底册成为此后宋辽交涉的地理与情报基准；他的采集有鲜明的结构：不是杂记见闻，而是按'可核对'的标准取舍——道里要能对里程，物产要能对市价，山川要能对舆图；后来编《华戎鲁卫信录》，他把两国外交文书与相关档案系统辑录成二百二十九卷——情报在他手里是分层的：底册是原始层，信录是编辑层，交涉决策是应用层；他证明：高质量情报的本质不是消息灵通，而是每一次出行都带着结构化的空白底册出门、带着可核对的底册回来
modes.domain_en: Twice envoy to Liao, Su Song traveled not with a mission and back with impressions but out with a baseline register and back with a baseline register: the passes and rivers, towns and distances, the intervals of the relay posts, products and customs, the truth of military reports — all noted on the road and redigested into a register on return, which became the geographic and intelligence base for Song-Liao negotiation; his gathering had a marked structure: not miscellaneous observation but selection by the standard of 'checkable' — distances to be checked by the li, products by market prices, passes by the maps; later, compiling the Record of Trust between Hua and the Foreign States, he systematized the two courts' diplomatic documents into 229 juan — intelligence in his hands was layered: the register the raw stratum, the record the edited stratum, negotiation the applied stratum; he proved that high-grade intelligence lies not in being well-informed but in going out each time with a structured blank register and coming back with one that can be checked
modes.source_chapter: 苏颂使辽诗及行程记事（两次使辽，一贺辽主生辰一正旦使）；苏颂主持编《华戎鲁卫信录》二百二十九卷事见《宋史·苏颂传》：《信录》'总为二百二十九卷'；使其辽行程见《苏魏公文集》卷十三前后使辽诗序
modes.key_quote_zh: 高质量情报的本质不是消息灵通，而是带着结构化的空白底册出门、带着可核对的底册回来
modes.key_quote_en: "High-grade intelligence lies not in being well-informed, but in going out with a structured blank register and coming back with one that can be checked."
process_zh: 出行前设计底册的列：按将来要回答的问题设计空白底册（道里、驿传、物产、人情、兵力），而不是回来再想记什么——采集的结构决定于用途，用途在出门前想清楚
只录可核对项：每条记录标注可被什么核对（里程对驿站、价格对市场、地形对舆图）——不可核对的传闻单独放一层，绝不与实测混编
归即整编成册：行程结束当天到一周内完成整理——记忆的半衰期以天计，底册的'核对面'在整理时才闭合
把底册升级为编年档案：像《信录》那样把单次采集放进两国关系的连续文档流——孤本的底册会散佚，进入连续档案的底册成为机构的资产
process_en: Design the register's columns before departure: plan the blank register by the questions it must later answer — distances, posts, products, tempers, forces — not decide on return what to note; the structure of gathering follows the use, and the use is settled before the door

Record only the checkable: mark each entry with what can check it — distance against the relay posts, price against the market, terrain against the maps; unverifiable rumor goes in a layer of its own, never mixed with measurement
Digest into the register on return: finish the redigestion within the week — memory's half-life is measured in days, and the register's face for checking closes only in the digesting

Raise the register into a chronological archive: as the Record of Trust placed single missions in the continuous document stream of two courts; a lone register scatters, a register inside a continuous archive becomes the institution's asset
representative_cases_zh: 使辽诗中的行程数据：苏颂的使辽诗不是抒情诗而是带注的行程志——诗题与自注记驿站名、里程、日期，构成完整的北行底册；文学形式被用成了数据载体
《华戎鲁卫信录》的编纂：他把自澶渊之盟以来的宋辽国书、誓书、边报系统整理成二百二十九卷，为交涉提供跨越百年的连续背景——单次出使的底册由此获得百年纵深
边情的虚实判读：底册的'可核对'标准让他在边报夸大时能指出具体矛盾——情报的价值不在多而在可校，这是底册对谣言的直接胜出
representative_cases_en: The travel data in the Liao poems: Su Song's envoy poems are not lyrics but annotated travel logs — titles and notes bearing the relay stations, distances and dates, a complete northern register; literary form used as a data carrier

The compiling of the Record of Trust: he ordered the letters, oaths and border reports between Song and Liao since the treaty of Chanyuan into 229 juan, giving negotiation a continuous century of context — the single mission's register gaining a hundred-year depth

Reading the truth of border reports: the checkable standard of the register let him point to concrete contradictions when reports were inflated — intelligence worth having lies in its checkability, not its quantity; this is the register's direct victory over rumor
modern_applications_zh: 出差/访谈的'底册模板'：每次外出前按决策问题设计结构化记录模板（价格、流程、关键人、约束），回来当天完成整编——零散见闻会蒸发，结构化底册会成为团队的地理底册
竞争情报的'可核对'纪律：每条竞品情报标注可验证源（公告、专利、招聘、发货记录），不可核对的传闻单列并标记置信度——底册法让情报会议从故事会变成核对会
机构记忆的《信录》化：把历次谈判、事故、决策的原始记录编成连续档案而非散落邮件——百年纵深的连续档案是任何新谈判者的先手
modern_applications_en: A register template for trips and interviews: before each trip design the structured template by the decision questions — prices, processes, key people, constraints — and digest it the day of return; scattered impressions evaporate, structured registers become the team's baseline map

The checkable discipline of competitive intelligence: tag each item with its verifiable source — announcements, patents, hires, shipping records — and quarantine rumor with a confidence mark; the register turns intelligence meetings from storytelling into checking

Turning institutional memory into a Record of Trust: compile the raw records of negotiations, incidents and decisions into a continuous archive, not scattered mail; a continuous archive of century depth is the first move of any new negotiator

modes.name_en: The Method of the Duke of Wei's Family Maxims
modes.category: 方法论/经验传承的案例化封装
modes.domain_zh: 苏颂晚年最大的作品不是哪一部书，而是一个传承系统的运转：他与子孙同住，亲自督课，为官原则、处世分寸、读书方法都以家训形式口传身教；关键在传承的载体设计：曾孙苏象先把这些言行系统记录成《魏公谭训》十卷——不是抽象格言集，而是'格言＋案例＋语境'的三层封装：每条训诫都带着发生时的具体情境，后人能从中推出训诫的适用边界；这份家训档案的效果是惊人的：苏家自苏颂后科举不断、子孙数代皆有闻人，家训甚至成为南宋士大夫家族教育的范本；苏颂证明：经验的传承不靠遗传也不靠权威，而靠一套被认真维护的案例档案——个人的判断力会随生命结束，被封装成案例的判断力可以再活五百年
modes.domain_en: Su Song's greatest late work was not any one book but the running of a transmission system: living with his sons and grandsons, he tutored them himself, passing on the principles of office, the measures of conduct, the ways of reading — as family maxims, spoken and shown; the crux lay in the design of the carrier: his great-grandson Su Xiangxian recorded it all systematically into the ten juan of the Family Talks of Duke Wei — not a book of bare maxims but a three-layer packaging of maxim, case and context: each admonition carries the situation of its occurrence, from which later readers can derive the bounds of its use; the effect was remarkable: after Su Song the Su family kept producing examination successes and noted men for generations, and the family talks became a model of gentry education in the Southern Song; Su Song proved that the transmission of experience rests neither on blood nor on authority but on a seriously maintained archive of cases — a person's judgment dies with him, but judgment packaged as cases can live five hundred years more
modes.source_chapter: 苏象先《魏公谭训》十卷（今存节本）：'公尝训子孙曰……'体例，每条皆记情境与缘起；《宋史·苏颂传》：'颂……与子弟延接，如布衣时'；苏氏家族科第世系见《魏公谭训》附录世系
modes.key_quote_zh: 个人的判断力会随生命结束，被封装成案例的判断力可以再活五百年
modes.key_quote_en: "A person's judgment dies with him; judgment packaged as cases can live five hundred years more."
process_zh: 与传承对象同居共事：苏颂与子孙同住亲课——传承发生在日常在场里，不在年度总结里；把自己的关键判断安排在有后人旁观与参与的场合
按'格言＋案例＋语境'封装：每条经验不单独说，而是带上它发生的情境（'某年某事，我因此知道……'）——语境让后人能推出格言的适用边界，防止家训变成教条
指定档案的记录人：主动把口传经验交给一个有义务且有能力记录的后人（苏象先）——没有指定记录人的口传经验，一代人就蒸发
为档案预留修订通道：《谭训》历经历代抄刻有节本流传——传承档案要允许每代人增删校订，活的档案才传得下去
process_en: Live and work with those to whom you transmit: Su Song dwelt with his sons and grandsons and tutored them himself — transmission happens in daily presence, not the annual review; arrange your key judgments where successors can watch and take part

Package as maxim, case and context: never state an experience alone but with the situation of its occurrence — 'in such a year, in such a matter, I therefore learned'; context lets successors derive the bounds of the maxim and keeps family talks from hardening into dogma

Name the record-keeper of the archive: hand your spoken experience to one successor with both the duty and the ability to write it down — as Su Xiangxian for Su Song; spoken experience with no named record-keeper evaporates in a generation

Leave the archive a channel of revision: the Family Talks passed through copying, printing and abridgement; a transmission archive must permit each generation to add, cut and correct — only a living archive carries down
representative_cases_zh: 《谭训》的'公尝训曰'体例：全书以'某事发生—祖父如何判断—训诫为何'的结构记录，读者拿到的是可推理的案例而不是必须背诵的结论——这是十一世纪的案例教学法
家训的具体内容：'人生要处，知人最难'、'不立异以邀名，不附势以固宠'、处世'如布衣时'——每条都对应苏颂五十六年宦海中可查的具体事件
苏家的世代产出：苏颂后人中进士不绝、曾孙辈仍有文集传世——家训档案的直接收益是家族的能力复利，其范本效应更外溢到南宋士族教育
representative_cases_en: The 'the duke once taught, saying' form of the Family Talks: the whole book records situation — judgment — lesson, giving readers cases to reason from, not conclusions to memorize — case method teaching in the eleventh century

The concrete content of the maxims: 'the hardest thing in life is to know men,' 'raise no novelty to court fame, cling to no faction,' living 'as when he was a commoner' — each anchored to checkable events in his fifty-six years of office

The generations of the Su house: examination successes unbroken after Su Song, great-grandsons with collected works still extant — the direct yield of the archive was the family's compounding capability, and its model effect spread to gentry education in the Southern Song
modern_applications_zh: 个人经验的三层封装写作：把你的核心工作诀窍写成'情境＋判断＋边界'的短文（而不是单句格言），每季度一篇传给团队——苏象先式的记录人要主动指定
家族/创始人知识的'谭训'工程：创业者把重大决策的当时情境、备选项与理由记录成内部档案，子女或继任者按案例学习——判断力的传承靠案例库，不靠股权
带语境的导师制：mentoring 时每个建议都附上你得到这个教训的真实事故——建议的适用边界只有从事故里才能学出来，苏颂的'与子弟延接如布衣时'就是让晚辈全程旁观判断现场
modern_applications_en: Three-layer packaging of one's experience: write each core knack as a short piece of situation — judgment — boundary, not a bare aphorism, one a quarter to the team; name your Su Xiangxian, the record-keeper, deliberately

The 'Family Talks' project for founders: record the situation, alternatives and reasons of each major decision in an internal archive for children or successors to learn as cases; judgment passes by a case library, not by equity

Mentoring with context: attach to every piece of advice the true incident where you learned it — the bounds of the advice can only be learned from the incident; Su Song's 'receiving his sons as when a commoner' meant letting the young watch the site of judgment in full
